title: Linear velocity expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be the correct formula, v = sqrt(GM/r).

title: Angular velocity expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be the correct formula, ω = sqrt(GM/r³).

title: First cosmic velocity
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be the correct formula, v₁ = sqrt(gR).

title: Applying Newton's law
description: Important: The solution should equate gravitational force to the required centripetal force (mv²/r or mω²r).

title: Deriving v₁ from g
description: Important: For part (3), the solution must relate surface gravity g to GM (using g = GM/R²) to derive the final expression.

title: Correct algebraic manipulation
description: Important: The algebra from force balance to the final velocity expressions must be logically sound and correctly executed.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The final answers should have correct implied units (e.g., m/s for velocity, rad/s for angular velocity).

title: Confusing radius variables
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student confuses orbital radius r with Earth's radius R, especially in parts (1)/(2) vs. (3).

title: Incorrect centripetal expression
description: Pitfall: Penalize using an incorrect form of centripetal acceleration (e.g., v²/r² for linear, wrong power for ω).
